card.name: Linking word before death in lists
card.fires_on: The word "and" or "or" that ends a list of bad outcomes, just before "death" or "fatal" is expected. Seen in warnings and trial endpoints.

modes.label: Outcome lists in warnings
modes.description: "or" or "and" after a run of harms such as brain damage, failure or disability, right before death.
modes.example: OSAGE MAY RESULT IN SEVERE RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION AND COMA, POSSIBLY LEADING TO PERMANENT BRAIN DAMAGE<< OR>> DEATH (SEE OVERDOSAGE

modes.label: Trial endpoint lists
modes.description: The linking word in a composite endpoint list whose last item is death.
